title: GeneralizedProSeRegulatoryArbitrage
description: Schema for generalized sovereign pro se statutory dispute filings against corporate statutory violations, enforcing regulatory arbitrage defense cost asymmetry (OPEN-PRO-SE-v1.0).

case_id.description: Unique SHA-256 derived identifier for the pro se litigation docket.

target_corporate_entity.description: Legal name or identifier of corporate defendant.

statutory_framework.description: Specific statutory reference violated (e.g., FCRA 15 U.S.C. § 1681, CIPA Cal. Penal Code § 631, TCPA 47 U.S.C. § 227, FDCPA 15 U.S.C. § 1692).

violation_count.description: Discrete number of verifiable statutory infractions.

statutory_damage_per_violation_usd.description: Statutory fixed damage floor per violation.

estimated_defense_hourly_rate_usd.description: Estimated billable rate of enterprise defense counsel per hour.

estimated_defense_hours.description: Minimum required billable legal hours to respond to and litigate a pro se docket.

estimated_counterparty_defense_cost_usd.description: Calculated total defense OpEx incurred by corporate entity.

asymmetry_ratio.description: Defense OpEx / Statutory Claim ratio (must be > 1.0 for favorable settlement leverage).

cfaa_compliant.description: Mandatory attestation that case generation incurred zero unauthorized system access.

pro_se_pleading_generated.description: True if complaint, summons, and statutory cure notices have been compiled on local edge silicon.
